description: Unit test class for HiveMqtt5ClientActor, testing MQTT client behavior with HiveMQ platform, including connection handling, subscription failure, and message processing.

classes.name: HiveMqtt5ClientActorTest

methods.description: Initializes the MQTT client before tests, mock setup and factory instantiation.

methods.name: createClientActorWithMessages
